Class LoggerFactory

java.lang.Object
tij.jca.logging.LoggerFactory
public final class LoggerFactory extends Object
Factory and global configuration entry point for application loggers.

LoggerFactory is responsible for creating logger instances and maintaining the logging implementation and global logging configuration used by the application.

The configured logger factory and logging configuration are stored in atomic references, allowing them to be safely replaced while the application is running.

By default, the factory uses NoLogger, meaning logging is effectively disabled until an actual logger implementation is configured.

  • Method Details

    • getLogger

      public static ILogger getLogger(Class<?> type)
      Creates a logger associated with the supplied class.

      The fully qualified name of the class is used as the logger's source prefix.

      Parameters:
      type - class to associate with the logger
      Returns:
      a logger associated with the supplied class
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if type is null

    • getLogger

      public static ILogger getLogger(String name)
      Creates a logger associated with the supplied name.

      The configured logger factory is used to create the logger. The logger is then initialized with the supplied source name and the currently configured output path.

      Parameters:
      name - name or source identifier associated with the logger
      Returns:
      a newly created logger
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if name is null

    • setLoggerFactory

      public static void setLoggerFactory(Supplier<ILogger> factory)
      Replaces the factory used to create logger instances.

      The supplied Supplier is invoked whenever a new logger is requested through getLogger(Class) or getLogger(String).

      Parameters:
      factory - factory responsible for creating logger instances
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if factory is null

    • setConfig

      public static void setConfig(ILogConfig config)
      Replaces the global logging configuration.

      The supplied configuration affects subsequently created loggers. Existing logger instances may retain the configuration state depending on their implementation.

      Parameters:
      config - global logging configuration
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if config is null

    • getConfig

      public static ILogConfig getConfig()
      Returns the currently configured global logging configuration.
